scenarios.name: payment-no-group
scenarios.description: Carlos pays Lucía CLP 10.000 and chooses no group

scenarios.name: payment-chosen-group
scenarios.description: Carlos pays Lucía CLP 10.000 and chooses Cuidado

scenarios.name: payment-full
scenarios.description: Carlos pays Lucía exactly the CLP 26.550 he owes

scenarios.name: payment-over
scenarios.description: Carlos pays Lucía CLP 30.000, leaving CLP 3.450 of credit in Cuidado

scenarios.name: edit-after-payment
scenarios.requirement: Section 6, when an expense is edited
scenarios.description: After a CLP 10.000 payment, Lucía corrects the lunch from CLP 84.000 to CLP 40.000

scenarios.name: edit-share-grows
scenarios.requirement: Section 6, when an expense is edited
scenarios.description: Papá raises the pizzas to CLP 60.000, so Carlos's settled share reopens for CLP 3.000

scenarios.name: edit-changes-payer
scenarios.requirement: Section 6, when an expense is edited
scenarios.description: The tablet turns out to be paid by Lucía, and Diego's payment moves to the older debt

scenarios.name: edit-changes-participants
scenarios.requirement: Section 6, when an expense is edited
scenarios.description: Diego is taken off the lunch, so the other four shares grow to CLP 21.000

scenarios.name: edit-changes-group
scenarios.requirement: Section 6, when an expense is edited
scenarios.description: The tablet moves from Cuidado to Toda la familia

scenarios.name: edit-changes-currency
scenarios.requirement: Section 6, when an expense is edited
scenarios.description: The therapy is corrected to CAD 200,00, and Diego's CLP 30.000 covers CAD 44,78 of it

scenarios.name: remove-member-clears-split
scenarios.description: Removing a member from a group with a usual split clears the split

scenarios.name: add-member-keeps-split
scenarios.description: A member added to a group with a usual split is stored with 0

scenarios.name: credit-pays-later-debt
scenarios.description: A new CLP 5.000 Comidas debt consumes the CLP 3.450 of credit held in Cuidado

scenarios.name: credit-after-debts-closed
scenarios.description: With every debt already closed, new credit still belongs to the group of the newest expense

scenarios.name: credit-order
scenarios.description: Credit in the expense's own group goes first, oldest first, before credit in other groups

scenarios.name: reverse-payment-reduces-credit
scenarios.description: Lucía pays back CLP 2.000 of the credit she owes Carlos

scenarios.name: backdated-expense
scenarios.requirement: Section 12, events are replayed in the order they were recorded
scenarios.description: An expense with an older date does not capture a payment recorded before it

scenarios.name: new-rates-keep-debts-closed
scenarios.description: A later rate entry neither reopens the closed debts nor moves the open ones

scenarios.name: full-payment-other-currency
scenarios.requirement: Section 7, full payments in another currency
scenarios.description: Carlos pays CAD 39,63 and the exact CLP 26.550 is credited

scenarios.name: credited-outside-tolerance
scenarios.requirement: Section 7, full payments in another currency
scenarios.description: Carlos pays CAD 40,00 claiming CLP 26.550, so exactly what was paid is credited
